1. Vikram asal mein kis cheez ke liye message kar raha tha, aur uske pehle do messages ki kaunsi details yeh dikhati hain? Uske aakhri do replies ka kya matlab hai?
2. Aman se exactly kahan galti hui? Uske har move ko evaluate karo — alternatives, cousin ka example, "discipline" wali line, "dus darwaze" wali line.
3. Aman ko ab repair ke liye jo message bhejna chahiye, bilkul waisa likho jaisa use bhejna chahiye.

1. Vikram asal mein apne exam result ke baare mein baat karne ke liye message kar raha tha. Uske pehle do messages mein yeh details hain ki uska result aaya aur woh list mein nahi hai, aur uska last attempt tha jismein usne dus saal mehnat ki thi aur papa ka retirement fund delhi coaching mein laga tha. Uske aakhri do replies mein woh Aman ke suggestions ko accept kar raha hai aur baad mein baat karne ka plan bana raha hai.

2. Aman se galti yeh hui ki usne Vikram ko bina uski feelings ko samjhe bina suggestions dena shuru kar diya. 
- "state PCS dekha hai?" aur "SSC CGL" ke suggestions dene se pehle usne Vikram ke emotions ko validate nahi kiya.
- Cousin ka example dena overconfident aur insensitive tha, kyunki har kisi ka journey alag hota hai.
- "Discipline aur GK toh mila" kehna thoda dismissive tha Vikram ke disappointment ko.
- "Ek darwaza band hota hai toh dus khulte hain" positive tha, lekin shayad us samay Vikram ko yeh samajh nahi aaya.

3. Aman ko repair ke liye yeh message bhejna chahiye:
"Yaar, sach mein tujhe dekh kar lag raha tha tu kitna mehnat kar raha tha. Result ke baad kaise feel kar rahe ho? Main yahan hoon, tujhe sunne ke liye. Agar tu ready hai toh hum plans pe baat kar sakte hain, वरना bas time pass karte hain."
